# Grid according to rotated-coordinate stripes: active line offsets bracket d at each sum u.
line_segments=[(8,10,22),(2,16,26),(1,1,7),(-3,3,9),(-3,19,23),(-7,7,9)]
out=[[8]*16 for _ in range(16)]
for r,cs in pts.items():
 for c in cs: out[r][c]=3
for r in range(16):
 for c in range(16):
  if out[r][c]!=8: continue
  u=r+c; d=c-r
  active=sorted(set(off for off,lo,hi in line_segments if lo<=u<=hi and (u-lo)%2==0))
  if any(a<d<b for a,b in zip(active,active[1:])): out[r][c]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
